notes: Discover V2 is a single-page application. Every state below renders from the one designFile; the state is reached either by the guided clicks described in entryInstructions or by opening the designFile with the given URL hash.

Hash keys are reference-only and not a prescribed API: m=mode(schools|agri), br=rent, r=region, p=directional sub-path, a=area, s=school, rad=school radius km, b=1 browse-all, ao=agri origin area, c=agri corridor, cl=agri town cluster, km=agri distance band.
data-design-screen on the app root equals the state id. data-design-component marks major component roots and matches VISUAL_RULES.md.
The exported build is Bangalore-only; other cities are coming-soon placeholders.

states.name: City overview — Areas
states.expectedHeading: Where do you want to explore?

mapIntent.orientationRule: Five region cards laid out by compass bearing (N top, E right, S bottom, W left, Central middle); width scales with inventory; orientation over exact position.

notes: Default landing. All five directions visible without scrolling.

states.name: Region → directional clusters (dense region)
entryInstructions: From city overview, select the North region (dense).

mapIntent.orientationRule: Generated sub-clusters positioned by bearing relative to the region; labelled by representative real-area names.

notes: Only appears when a region exceeds the split threshold (>8 areas and >=2 sub-groups). Recurses: choosing a cluster deepens the directional sub-path and may show further clusters before areas.

states.name: Region → areas (shallow region)
entryInstructions: From city overview, select the South region (few areas, no cluster level).

mapIntent.orientationRule: Areas shown on real coordinates; map fits real region bounds.

notes: Demonstrates the omitted optional cluster level — region goes straight to areas.

states.name: Area results — residential listings
entryInstructions: Pick an area (e.g. Hebbal), by drill-down or via autocomplete.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Real listing pins with proximity clustering; camera fits the area bounds.

notes: Results workspace: compact header, property-search (within-area), essential filter chips, Schools shortcut, listing grid.
Includes a school-shortcut that switches to Schools mode keeping this area.

states.name: Area results — property search active
entryInstructions: In an area results page, type a term into the property-search and submit.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Pins reflect the filtered subset.

notes: Section header shows 'N of M' with a Reset action. Empty subset shows the designed 'No homes match' empty state.
This is a within-area filter, not the global autocomplete.

states.name: Area results — property filters active
entryInstructions: In an area results page, toggle Type / Beds / Verified-only chips.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Pins reflect the filtered subset.

notes: Filters are compact chips (type, bedrooms, verified-only), not a tall form.

states.name: Browse all listings
entryInstructions: Click 'Browse all listings' on the mode row.

mapIntent.orientationRule: All in-scope listings as clustered pins.

notes: Flat filterable list of every verified home in scope; no area selected.

states.name: City switcher open (overlay)
entryInstructions: Click the city name in the control bar.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Overlay only; underlying state unchanged.

notes: Listbox with Bangalore (live, checked) and Mumbai/Pune/Hyderabad (disabled, 'Soon'). Overlay on any screen.
unresolved: NOT_DESIGNED: switching to a second live city — only Bangalore is designed.

states.name: Area autocomplete open (overlay)
entryInstructions: Type in the control-bar area search.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Overlay only until a result is chosen.

notes: Up to 6 results; action label + result set are mode-aware. Empty query shows nothing; no matches shows an inline message. Resolves to the same canonical state as guided drill-down.

states.name: City overview — Schools

mapIntent.orientationRule: Same compass layout as Areas, filtered to regions that contain schools; plum accent.

notes: Switching from Areas to Schools keeps the current geographic context where possible.

states.name: Region → areas with schools
entryInstructions: In Schools mode, select the North region.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Only areas that contain schools; real positions.

notes: With the current data no region exceeds the split threshold in Schools mode, so Schools skips clusters and shows areas directly.
unresolved: NOT_DESIGNED (data-dependent): a Schools directional-cluster level — the code path exists (mirrors Areas) but no region has enough school-areas to trigger it in this build. Confirm expected behaviour if a future city does.

states.name: Schools within an area (+ search + filters)
entryInstructions: Pick an area in Schools mode (e.g. Hebbal), or search it.

mapIntent.orientationRule: School pins on real coordinates; area retained as context; plum accent.

notes: Selected area is retained (heading + context). School search + board/level filters. Homes in the area are also shown beneath the school controls.

states.name: School search / filters active
entryInstructions: In the schools-in-area state, type a school name or toggle Board/Level chips.

mapIntent.orientationRule: School pins reflect the filtered subset.

notes: Empty subset shows the designed 'No schools match' empty state with a clear-filters action.

states.name: Homes near a selected school (+ radius)

mapIntent.orientationRule: Dashed plum radius circle around the school; homes within radius as pins; camera fits the circle.

notes: Radius 3/5/10 km with live counts; homes sorted by distance and show a distance chip. Empty radius shows a 'No homes within N km' state offering a wider radius.

states.name: Agricultural overview — city origin

mapIntent.orientationRule: Four outbound direction cards (N/E/S/W) positioned by bearing from the city centre; evergreen accent.

notes: Origin defaults to city centre; all four agricultural directions visible without unnecessary scrolling.

states.name: Agricultural overview — area origin
entryInstructions: In Agricultural mode, search an area as origin (e.g. Hebbal), or carry an area in from Areas mode.

mapIntent.orientationRule: Origin pin at the area; corridors reframed by real bearing/distance from that origin (not the city).

notes: Direction labels and distance ranges are recomputed relative to the area origin. A reset action returns to the city-centre origin. Breadcrumb must not imply farmland belongs inside the origin area.

states.name: Outbound direction → towns by distance (+ sector)
entryInstructions: Hash: #m=agri&c=n-doddaballapur (add &km=25 for a distance band; &ao=<area> for an area origin)
states.expectedHeading: North towards Doddaballapur (city origin) or 'North of <origin>' (area origin)

mapIntent.orientationRule: Translucent evergreen search sector (wedge + cumulative distance arcs) from origin toward the corridor bearing; town discs on real coordinates. Sector is scope, not a boundary.

notes: Distance bands 10/25/50/100 km are cumulative (larger band includes nearer towns). Town search filters within the corridor. Empty band shows 'No towns within N km' with a Widen action.

states.name: Town → agricultural parcel results

mapIntent.orientationRule: Parcel pins (acreage) on real coordinates; camera fits the town bounds.

notes: Parcel search + agri filters (size, price, soil, road, water). Empty subset shows 'No parcels match' with a clear action.

states.name: City overview — Areas (mobile)
states.expectedHeading: Where do you want to explore?

mapIntent.orientationRule: Map is a top band (~42% height, min 260px); compass re-centres for the narrower map.

notes: Stacked layout: map on top, results panel slides up as a rounded sheet with a grab handle. Global controls wrap onto multiple rows.

states.name: Area results (mobile)

mapIntent.orientationRule: Map top band; panel sheet beneath with elevation.

notes: Listing grid collapses to a single column (<560px). Same components as desktop area results.

undesignedStates: NOT_DESIGNED: loading / skeleton states for any journey.
NOT_DESIGNED: deep link to unavailable data (suggested intent: fall back to nearest valid ancestor level).
NOT_DESIGNED: map-tile failure while panel data is available (panel is usable without the map).
NOT_DESIGNED: listing / school / parcel DETAIL pages (cards link to 'View details' / 'View parcel' but the detail view itself is out of scope for this export).
NOT_DESIGNED: switching to a second live city (only Bangalore is designed).
NOT_DESIGNED (data-dependent): a Schools directional-cluster level (code path exists; not reachable with current data).
